title: 第13章 菜里没药酒里有第14章 纪慕青
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
秦家。
“家主！家主！”
秦家宅院内，下人神色慌张，匆匆跑到秦阳明面前。
此刻的秦阳明，鼻青脸肿，浑身散发着一股颓败之气，重伤在身，每挪动一下，都似有万针攒刺。
“何事如此惊慌？”秦阳明强撑着一口气，声音沙哑。
“小的……小的联系上大小姐秦易烟了。”下人小心翼翼地说道。
秦阳明眼中瞬间闪过一丝光亮，急切问道：“她怎么说？”
“大小姐回话说，她目前正在修炼的紧要关头，”下人顿了顿，接着道，“不过一月后的宗门收徒，她定会回到洛安城。”
秦阳明紧攥拳头，关节泛白，心中满是不甘与愤恨。
“大小姐还说，父亲的仇、弟弟的仇，还有家族的仇，她定要让苏家、林家付出惨痛代价！”下人又补充道。
秦阳明听闻，仰头望天，眼眶泛红，内心苦涩：“易烟呐，家族如今深陷泥沼，就盼你能归来力挽狂澜了。苏家、林家，你们给我等着，待我女儿回来，定要你们血债血偿！”
在这秦家之内，气氛压抑得仿若能滴出水来，秦阳明拖着那重伤之躯，一步一步艰难地踱步，脑海中不断浮现出被苏老爷子重创的画面，每一幕都如刀割般刺痛他的心。
“苏家、林家，你们这群卑鄙小人，竟敢如此欺我秦家！”秦阳明忍不住低声咆哮，那声音中饱含着无尽的怨怒。
而远在紫云宗的秦易烟，此时正于一处灵气氤氲的山洞中闭关修炼。她身姿动人，肌肤胜雪，三千青丝如瀑般垂下，眉眼间透着一股与生俱来的英气。
“父亲、弟弟，你们放心，等我此次突破，定要让苏家、林家为他们的所作所为付出难以承受的代价！”秦易烟在心中暗暗发誓，随后双眸紧闭，周身灵气如汹涌浪潮，疯狂涌动起来。
苏家。
苏家老爷子苏圣杰满脸慈爱，大手一挥，将家族宝库大门轰然敞开，声若洪钟道：“铭儿，此番你要前往紫云宗，这家族宝库中的修炼资源，你随意挑选，千万别客气！”
苏铭心中暖意流淌，面上却极为沉稳，微微摇头，轻声说道：“爷爷，孙儿谢过您的厚爱。但孙儿无需太多，拿些灵药便可。”
苏圣杰眉头轻皱，眼中满是不解，问道：“铭儿，这是为何？宝库之中，天材地宝众多，随便一件都能助你在修炼之途突飞猛进，你怎就只要灵药？”
苏铭目光坚定，缓缓解释道：“爷爷，此前您已然给了孙儿大量的灵石。如今苏家也需这些资源发展，若孙儿拿得过多，苏家定会陷入窘迫，往后诸多事务恐难开展。孙儿明白轻重，灵药于我而言，已然足够。”

苏圣杰长叹一声，眼中满是欣慰，感慨道：“铭儿，你能这般顾全大局，实乃苏家之幸啊！”
苏铭挑选好灵药，回到别院。他双眸瞬间燃起炽热光芒，仿佛两簇跳动的火焰，满是兴奋与期待。
“今日，便要用这些灵药，炼制神行丹与灵魄丹！”苏铭喃喃自语，声音中透着一股不容置疑的坚毅。
他迅速布置好丹炉，那丹炉古朴厚重，炉身上刻满神秘符文，在光芒映照下，隐隐闪烁着奇异光泽。苏铭双手如幻影般舞动，将一株株灵药精准投入丹炉之中。
“这株百年血灵草，蕴含磅礴生机，是炼制神行丹的关键。”苏铭一边投放灵药，一边口中念念有词。
紧接着，他掌心涌起一团炽热火焰，那火焰呈幽蓝色，温度极高，瞬间将丹炉包裹。苏铭额头上豆大的汗珠滚落，却浑然不觉，全神贯注地控制着火焰温度。
“温度再高些许，神行丹的药效方能更上一层楼！”苏铭牙关紧咬，眼神中满是决绝。
随着时间缓缓流逝，丹炉中渐渐散发出阵阵奇异香气，那香气弥漫开来，整个别院都仿佛被一层神秘的光晕笼罩。
“成了！”苏铭猛地大喝一声，双手快速结印，丹炉盖子“砰”的一声弹开，28枚圆润饱满、散发着璀璨光芒的臻品神行丹，如灵动的小鸟般飞出。
content_en:
Qin family.
"Master! Master!"
In the Qin family's courtyard, the servants looked panicked and hurried to Qin Yangming.
At this moment, Qin Yangming had a bruised nose and swollen face. He exuded a sense of decadence and was seriously injured. Every time he moved, he seemed to be pricked by thousands of needles.
"Why are you so panicked?" Qin Yangming took a deep breath, his voice hoarse.
"Little... I have contacted the eldest lady Qin Yiyan." The servant said cautiously.
Qin Yangming's eyes suddenly flashed with light, and he asked eagerly: "What did she say?"
"The eldest lady replied that she is currently at a critical juncture in her cultivation," the servant paused, then continued, "But when the sect recruits disciples in one month, she will definitely return to Luo'an City."
Qin Yangming clenched his fists tightly, his joints turning white, and his heart was full of unwillingness and resentment.
"The eldest lady also said that she will make the Su family and the Lin family pay a heavy price for her father's hatred, her brother's hatred, and the family's hatred!" the servant added.
When Qin Yangming heard this, he looked up at the sky, his eyes were red, and he felt bitter in his heart: "Yi Yan, our family is in deep quagmire now, and I hope you can come back to turn the tide. Su family, Lin family, just wait for me. When my daughter comes back, you will pay with your blood!"
In the Qin family, the atmosphere was so oppressive that it was like dripping water. Qin Yangming dragged his seriously injured body and paced hard step by step. The scene of being severely injured by Mr. Su kept appearing in his mind. Every scene hurt his heart like a knife.
"Su family, Lin family, you despicable people, how dare you bully my Qin family like this!" Qin Yangming couldn't help but roar in a low voice, his voice full of endless resentment.
Qin Yiyan, who was far away in Ziyun Sect, was currently practicing in seclusion in a cave filled with spiritual energy. Her figure is moving, her skin is as good as snow, three thousand black hairs hang down like a waterfall, and there is an innate heroic spirit between her eyebrows.
"Father, brother, don't worry. When I make a breakthrough this time, I will make the Su family and the Lin family pay an unbearable price for what they have done!" Qin Yiyan swore secretly in his heart, then closed his eyes tightly, and the aura around him surged like a raging wave, crazily.
Su family.
The old man of the Su family, Su Shengjie, had a loving face. With a wave of his hand, he opened the door of the family treasure house and said in a loud voice: "Ming'er, you are going to Ziyun Sect this time. You can choose the cultivation resources in the family treasure house as you please. Don't be polite!"
Warmth flowed in Su Ming's heart, but his face was extremely calm. He shook his head slightly and said softly: "Grandpa, my grandson thanks you for your love. But my grandson doesn't need much, just get some elixir."
Su Shengjie frowned slightly, his eyes full of confusion, and asked: "Ming'er, why is this? There are many treasures in the treasure house, and any one of them can help you make rapid progress in your cultivation. Why do you only want the elixir?"
Su Ming's eyes were firm and he explained slowly: "Grandpa, you have given your grandson a large amount of spiritual stones before. Now the Su family also needs these resources to develop. If the grandson takes too much, the Su family will be in embarrassment and many things will be difficult to carry out in the future. My grandson understands the importance, and the spiritual medicine is enough for me."
Su Shengjie let out a long sigh, his eyes full of relief, and said with emotion: "Ming'er, you are so lucky to take the overall situation into consideration!"
Su Ming selected the elixir and returned to the other courtyard. His eyes instantly ignited with blazing light, like two clusters of beating flames, full of excitement and anticipation.
"Today, we will use these elixirs to refine the Divine Movement Pill and the Soul Pill!" Su Ming murmured to himself, with an undoubted perseverance in his voice.
He quickly arranged the alchemy furnace. The alchemy furnace was simple and heavy, and its body was engraved with mysterious runes. Under the light, it shimmered with a strange luster. Su Ming's hands danced like phantoms, and he accurately dropped each elixir into the alchemy furnace.
"This century-old blood spirit grass contains majestic vitality and is the key to refining the magic elixir." Su Ming muttered words while putting in the elixir.
Immediately afterwards, there was a surge in his palmA ball of blazing flame, the flame was blue in color and extremely high in temperature, instantly surrounding the alchemy furnace. Big beads of sweat rolled down Su Ming's forehead, but he didn't notice it and was concentrating on controlling the temperature of the flame.
"The higher the temperature, the more effective the Shenxing Dan will be!" Su Ming clenched his teeth, his eyes full of determination.
As time passed slowly, bursts of strange aroma gradually emitted from the alchemy furnace. The aroma filled the air, and the entire courtyard seemed to be shrouded in a mysterious halo.
"It's done!" Su Ming shouted loudly, quickly formed seals with his hands, and the lid of the alchemy furnace popped open with a "bang", and 28 round, full, and radiant Zhenpin Shenxing Dan flew out like a nimble bird.
